text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Service /v1/generate p99 latency breach in eu-west-1. p99=1.28s (5m window), request count=240. PagerDuty triggered (PD# P12345) — page fired to oncall rotation.

sam (oncall): ack. I'm on it, looking at dashboards now.

maya: digging into kvcache and sidecar queues. Starting with hit-rate and queue depth.

leo: FYI I can route traffic to a fallback model variant (model-quant-2) if we need an immediate mitigant. Any customer errors reported?

sam (oncall): dashboard: sidecar queue depth up ~3.6x, kv_cache_hit_rate dropped from 78% -> 21% last 10m. No 5xx spikes in app logs, mostly latency.

maya: running quick checks — grabbing top hot keys and pod memory.

maya: ```
# check sidecar metrics
kubectl exec -n inference svc/sidecar-metrics -- curl -s http://localhost:9090/metrics | grep kv_cache_hit_rate
# check pod queue depth
kubectl top pod -n inference | sort -k2 -nr | head -n 10
```

ops-runner-bot: Autoscaler events: scale-up attempted @ 2026-03-17T12:04:00Z and 12:08:00Z. Node quota hit on eu-west cluster (no available host capacity), scale-up failed for 2 pods.

maya: confirmed node quota. I'm going to flush the local prefix cache for the busiest shard to try to recover hit-rate (non-disruptive attempt). Running curl to cache admin endpoint.

maya: ```
# flush prefix cache on node-5
curl -X POST https://kvcache-admin.eu-west.internal/flush_prefix -d '{"prefix":"chat-model-v2:user:"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'
```

sam (oncall): flushing done. Observing hit-rate jump to ~65% on flushed shard, overall p99 trending down.

leo: rolling 30% of traffic to model-quant-2 fallback now (gradual). If latency improves we can keep fallback until autoscaler/nodes are resolved.

sam (oncall): after routing 30% to fallback: p99 dropped to 0.72s, p95 ~180ms. Good short-term win.

maya: support: pinged CS to notify EU customers — no user-visible 5xx but increased latency for a subset. Raising proactive communication.

ops-runner-bot: Created incident ticket INC-2026-342 (priority P1-latency). Linked to PD# P12345.

sam (oncall): leaving notes in runbook: kvcache eviction likely due to node pressure + hotkey amplification. Steps taken: flushed prefix, partial traffic reroute to quant-2, created ticket.

sam (oncall): handing to next oncall @jordan in ~15m for 2h watch. Will stay available for questions.

jordan: ack. I'll take monitor and escalation if it re-breaches. Please add any relevant logs to the incident ticket. :thumbsup:

sam (oncall): thanks team — keeping PD open until autoscaler can actually provision nodes or we finish shifting traffic. Will update if we see new anomalies.
